description: Sub-leading (h⁴) coefficient D(n) of the W_λ defect 1−Z(n)=C(n)h²+D(n)h⁴+O(h⁶), n=2..10. Tests whether D(n) is a clean polynomial in n (a second q₀-free falsifiable target) via Richardson extraction + finite-difference polynomiality test. No fit.
h_convention: h = q - 1/q; D(n) = h^4 Taylor coeff of 1-Z(n) about h=0 via mp.taylor (method-validated against proved-exact C(n), err 0.0; tight 1e-25 rational tol)

method_validation.check: h^2 Taylor coeff vs proved-exact C(n)=-n(n-1)(2n-13)/144

verdict: D(n) IS a clean polynomial in n of degree 6 (constant Δ^6). The W_λ defect's h⁴ coefficient is therefore a SECOND exact, q₀-free falsifiable target: the geometric index's 4th heat-kernel coefficient must equal D(n). Combined with the leading cubic C(n), the keystone gate now carries two exact polynomial targets per n, not one. No fit — D(n) extracted by high-precision Taylor expansion (method-validated: the h² coeff reproduces the proved-exact C(n) to 0.0), degree proven by finite differences (Δ⁶ constant to ~1e-120), closed form by exact interpolation + held-out validation. The exact closed form is D(n) = (828·n^1 + -625·n^2 + 5070·n^3 + -6745·n^4 + 1572·n^5 + -100·n^6)/1036800, interpolated from n=2..8 and VALIDATED on held-out n=[9, 10].
